title: Equipped operations workshop
summary: The operations garage now has an organized service bay and proper workshop equipment.
notes: Add a steel workbench with a mounted vise, socket tray, hanging spanners, screwdrivers and drawer storage.
Equip the workshop with a rolling tool chest, compressor and air hose, tire rack, floor jack and mechanic's creeper.
Clear loose clutter, mark the vehicle service bay and keep spawn, travel and workbench routes clear.
